user.title: Connect to Thessla Green
user.description: Select the ventilation unit family and enter the settings of its Modbus TCP gateway.

data_description.device_family: Select the closest known family. Use Other / unknown for models that are not listed.
data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the Modbus gateway.
data_description.framer: Use RTU for a transparent serial gateway and socket for a Modbus TCP protocol converter.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit address of the Thessla Green controller. The factory default is 10.

init.title: Optional Thessla Green capabilities
init.description: Enable only capabilities supported by this controller. Unsupported register ranges are not probed automatically.

data_description.constant_flow: Enable registers for units equipped with Constant Flow airflow control.
